CREATE TABLE `api_logs` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `unique_visitor_id` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `method` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

  `request_payload` longtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `response_payload` longtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `status_code` int NOT NULL,
  `ip_address` varchar(45) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `user_agent` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `api_logs_endpoint_index` (`endpoint`),
  KEY `api_logs_unique_visitor_id_index` (`unique_visitor_id`),
  KEY `api_logs_ip_address_index` (`ip_address`),

) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=77192 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

sample_rows.name: Neuro-linguistic programming (NLP)  Batch 3
sample_rows.description: Neuro-Linguistic Programming (NLP) is a method that explores the connection between neurological processes, language, and behavioral patterns to understand and influence human experience. It focuses on how our thoughts (neuro), language (linguistic), and behaviors (programming) interact to shape our reality and how these patterns can be modified for personal development and achieving specific goals. Essentially, NLP aims to help individuals understand how they create their reality and empowers them to change behaviors and thought patterns for better outcomes.

CREATE TABLE `videos` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  `category_id` int NOT NULL,

  `description` longtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,

  `video_json_data` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `hls_path` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_converted_hls_video` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `thumbnail` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `duration` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,

sample_rows.title: Ho'oponopono Day 1
sample_rows.description: On the first day of practicing Ho'oponopono, you begin by acknowledging feelings, thoughts, and actions that cause anger, fear, illness, or suffering, and then, with reverence, silently repeat the four phrases: "I am sorry, Please forgive me, Thank you, I love you".

sample_rows.title: Ho'oponopono  Day 2
sample_rows.description: In the context of the Ho'oponopono practice, the second step, often described as "Day 2," involves asking for forgiveness, acknowledging the other person's feelings, and expressing remorse for the harm caused.

sample_rows.title: Ho'oponopono Day 3
sample_rows.description: Ho'oponopono, meaning "to make right," is a Hawaiian practice emphasizing self-responsibility and reconciliation, involving acknowledging wrongdoing, seeking forgiveness, expressing gratitude, and offering love.

sample_rows.title: Ho'oponopono Day 4
sample_rows.description: Ho'oponopono, a Hawaiian practice, aims to restore balance and heal relationships through a simple mantra: "I'm sorry, please forgive me, thank you, I love you". It's a tool for self-love and reconciliation, encouraging forgiveness and understanding.

sample_rows.title: Ho'oponopono Day 5
sample_rows.description: On Day 5 of a Ho'oponopono practice, focus on taking 100% responsibility for your thoughts and actions, and the world around you, using the mantra "I'm sorry, Please forgive me, Thank you, I love you" to clear any unwanted emotions and promote healing.

sample_rows.title: Ho'oponopono, Day 6
sample_rows.description: Ho'oponopono, meaning "to make right," is a Hawaiian practice focused on self-forgiveness and reconciliation, aiming to restore harmony and balance in relationships and with oneself. It involves acknowledging wrongdoing, expressing remorse, asking for forgiveness, and releasing negativity

sample_rows.title: Ho'oponopono Day 7
sample_rows.description: A 7-day Ho'oponopono challenge aims to cultivate healing, forgiveness, and self-love through the practice of the Ho'oponopono mantra: "I'm sorry, please forgive me, thank you, I love you," and other related practices.

sample_rows.title: Neuro-linguistic programming (NLP) Day 1
sample_rows.description: On day one of an NLP (Neuro-Linguistic Programming) training, you'll likely be introduced to fundamental concepts, including the history and principles of NLP, the importance of sensory experience, and techniques for building rapport and communication skills.

sample_rows.title: Neuro-Linguistic Programming (NLP) Day 2
sample_rows.description: On Day 2 of a Neuro-Linguistic Programming (NLP) workshop, you can expect to delve into topics like belief change, public speaking, emotional intelligence, and techniques such as the Swish technique, sensory acuity, and rapport building, all while exploring NLP's core principles and applications.
